_comment: SCC-212 declared mutant table — written BEFORE the sweep ran. Every mutant is drawn from the SHIPPED text or the guard's own predicates, never from the cases. M1-M8 attack the parity guard (identity, symmetry, the declared set); M9-M14 revert a ported obligation; M15 deletes the loaded rule from the block the LOADERS row iterates. ⛔ mutation_sweep validates with `not m.get(k)`, so an EMPTY `mutated` reads as MISSING and the table is refused: a pure deletion is inexpressible. Deletions are spelled as a replacement with a neutral line that carries none of the law.
